## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

No curated parallels or cross-language alignments with Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora are recorded [DharmaNexus]. However, automated text-reuse analysis identifies 62 matching passages shared with 28 other Pali texts, highlighting the highly formulaic character of Apadāna verse compositions [DharmaNexus]. The text shares extensive verse runs—particularly between segments §2.2 and §8.1—with other poems in the collection, such as the *Ketakapupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 516), the *Nāgapupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 517), the *Pāṭihīrasaññakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 435), and the *Saḷalamaṇḍapiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 400) [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, lines from segment §3 (§3.1–3.4) are paralleled in the first volume of the Theragāthā commentary (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*) [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
